entities.summary: Giuseppe Filippi is an Italian Roman Catholic priest who served as the Bishop of the Diocese of Kotido, from 17 August 2009 to 25 October 2022. He was appointed Apostolic Administrator of Kotido Diocese on 25 October 2022.
